ק.ja: כקול אלכתאב מלפנו מבהמות ארץ ומעוף השמים יחכמנו,
ק.en: As for the rational: the intellect bears witness that the bounty of the rational over the non-rational is only by the bounty of its discernment and its receptivity to the secrets of wisdom — as the Book says: "Who teaches us by means of the beasts of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the heavens" (Job 35:11).

pairs.en: as the Book says
Who teaches us by means of the beasts of the earth
and makes us wiser than the birds of the heavens

ק.ja: פאד'א אסתעמל אלאנסאן פכרה ופהמה פי אסראר אלחכמה ואעתבאר את'ארהא כאן פצ'לה עלי אלבהימה בחסב ד'לך,
ק.en: When a man employs his thought and his understanding in the secrets of wisdom and in reflection upon its traces, his bounty over the brute beast is according to that.

pairs.en: When a man employs
his thought and his understanding
in the secrets of wisdom
and in reflection upon its traces
his bounty over the brute beast
is according to that

ק.ja: ואן גפל ענהא כאן מת'ל אלבהימה, בל אנקץ מנהא, נט'יר קול אלכתאב ידע שור קונהו וחמור אבוס בעליו ישראל לא ידע עמי לא התבונן.
ק.en: But if he is heedless of them, he is like the brute beast — indeed, lower than it — as the Book says: "The ox knows its owner, and the ass its master's crib; Israel does not know, My people does not consider" (Isaiah 1:3).

pairs.en: But if he is heedless of them
he is like the brute beast
indeed, lower than it
as the Book says
The ox knows its owner
and the ass its master's crib
Israel does not know
My people does not consider

ק.ja: ואמא מן אלמכתוב, פקול אלכתאב שאו מרום עיניכם וראו מי ברא אלה,
ק.en: As for the scriptural: the saying of the Book: "Lift up your eyes on high and see: who created these?" (Isaiah 40:26).

pairs.en: As for the scriptural
the saying of the Book
Lift up your eyes on high
and see: who created these

ק.ja: וקאל אלולי כי אראה שמיך מעשה אצבעותיך ירח וככבים אשר כוננת,
ק.en: And the Friend said: "When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars which You have established" (Psalms 8:4).

pairs.en: And the Friend said
When I behold Your heavens
the work of Your fingers
the moon and the stars
which You have established

ק.ja: וקאל אלכתאב הלא תדעו הלא תשמעו הלא הגד מראש לכם הלא הבינותם מוסדות הארץ,
ק.en: And the Book said: "Will you not know? Will you not hear? Has it not been told to you from the beginning? Have you not understood the foundations of the earth?" (Isaiah 40:21).

pairs.en: And the Book said
Will you not know
Will you not hear
Has it not been told to you from the beginning
Have you not understood the foundations of the earth

ק.ja: וקאל החרשים שמעו והעורים הביטו לראות,
ק.en: And He said: "You deaf, hear, and you blind, look that you may see" (Isaiah 42:18).

pairs.en: And He said
You deaf, hear
and you blind, look that you may see

ק.ja: וקאל טוב ללכת אל בית אבל מלכת אל בית משתה באשר הוא סוף כל האדם והחי יתן אל לבו,
ק.en: And He said: "Better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting, for that is the end of every man, and the living shall lay it to his heart" (Ecclesiastes 7:2).

pairs.en: And He said
Better to go to the house of mourning
than to go to the house of feasting
for that is the end of every man
and the living shall lay it to his heart

ק.ja: וקאל החכם עיניו בראשו והכסיל בחשך הולך,
ק.en: And He said: "The wise man's eyes are in his head, but the fool walks in darkness" (Ecclesiastes 2:14).

pairs.en: And He said
The wise man's eyes are in his head
but the fool walks in darkness

ק.ja: וקאל וארח צדיקים כאור נגה הולך ואור עד נכון היום, דרך רשעים כאפלה לא ידעו במה יכשלו.
ק.en: And He said: "The path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, shining ever brighter unto the established day; the way of the wicked is like darkness, they do not know in what they stumble" (Proverbs 4:18–19).

pairs.en: And He said
The path of the righteous is like the light of dawn
shining ever brighter unto the established day
the way of the wicked is like darkness
they do not know in what they stumble

ק.ja: ואמא מן אלמנקול, פקול אואילנא ע"ס כל היודע לחשב בתקופות ומזלות ואינו מחשב עליו הכתוב אומר והיה כנור ונבל תוף וחליל ויין משתיהם ואת פעל ה' לא יביטו ומעשה ידיו לא ראו,
ק.en: As for the transmitted: the saying of our early ones (peace be upon them): "Whoever is able to compute the cycles and the constellations and does not compute — concerning him Scripture says, And the harp and the lyre, the tambourine and the flute and wine are at their feasts, but they do not look at the work of the Lord, and they do not see the doing of His hands" (b. Shabbat 75a, citing Isaiah 5:12).

pairs.en: As for the transmitted
the saying of our early ones
Whoever is able to compute the cycles and the constellations
and does not compute
concerning him Scripture says
And the harp and the lyre, the tambourine and the flute
and wine are at their feasts
but they do not look at the work of the Lord
and they do not see the doing of His hands

ק.ja: וקאלוא מנין שחייב אדם לחשב בתקופות ומזלות שנאמר ושמרתם ועשיתם כי היא חכמתכם ובינתכם לעיני העמים, איזו היא חכמה ובינה שהיא לעיני העמים, הוי אומר זה חשוב תקופות ומזלות.
ק.en: And they said: "Whence that a man is obligated to compute the cycles and the constellations? As it is said: And you shall observe and you shall do, for that is your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the peoples (Deuteronomy 4:6) — what wisdom and understanding is there in the eyes of the peoples? — say: the computation of cycles and constellations" (b. Shabbat 75a).

pairs.en: And they said

pairs.ja: מנין שחייב אדם לחשב בתקופות ומזלות
pairs.en: Whence that a man is obligated to compute the cycles and the constellations

the computation of cycles and constellations

ק.ja: וקאלוא והוי מחשב הפסד מצוה כנגד שכרה ושכר עברה כנגד הפסדה.
ק.en: And they said: "Compute the loss of a commandment against its reward, and the reward of a transgression against its loss" (m. Avot 2:1).

pairs.en: And they said

pairs.ja: והוי מחשב הפסד מצוה כנגד שכרה
pairs.en: Compute the loss of a commandment against its reward
and the reward of a transgression against its loss

ק.ja: וקאלוא אלמלא נתנה תורה לישראל למדנו צניעות מחתול, עריות מיונה, דרך ארץ מתרנגול, גזל מנמלה.
ק.en: And they said: "Had the Torah not been given to Israel, we should have learned chastity from the cat, aversion to forbidden unions from the dove, propriety from the rooster, and not to rob from the ant" (b. Eruvin 100b).

pairs.en: And they said
Had the Torah not been given to Israel

propriety from the rooster
and not to rob from the ant

ק.ja: פקד צח וג'וב אלאעתבאר באלמכ'לוקין ואלאסתדלאל באת'אר אלחכמה, פאפהם.
ק.en: Thus the obligation of reflecting upon created things, and of drawing inference from the traces of wisdom, has been established — so understand.

pairs.en: the obligation of reflecting upon created things
and of drawing inference from the traces of wisdom
so understand
